mission.title: The Sheeted Dead
mission.description: Cleanse the overridden programs left by Carlyne and Halborn's battle, and bring the untouched code fragments to Agent Pace.

npc.say:
No, really, I'm fine. She wouldn't let them.
I'm fine.
Ooh, darn. Where'd I leave my mocha?
Oh... Nothing. It's just unusual... That's all.

Don't touch anything.
That goes for the technicians, too!
These nerds are creeping me out.

phase.briefing:
The battle between Carlyne and Halborn has left large areas of Richland suffering from a massive influx of code overrides. System programs are unable to approach the area. This has made it difficult to examine the battle site, but long range scans have failed to detect any trace of the combatants. Until we are able to obtain confirmation to the contrary, we must assume that both survived the encounter.
In their absence, our most pressing problem is the code override situation in Richland. Your first task is to cleanse the indicated area of overridden programs, and to evacuate any surviving civilians you find there. Even after removal of the overridden programs, it will take some time to restore full functionality to the simulation in the affected areas.

enter.say: Man, I've got background noise from override codes clogging up all of my readings in there. From what Gray said, it sounded like you should expect a lot of hostile programs.

done.say: I think that's got 'em. We must have lost a ton of programs from this...

complete.say: ... Looks like we won't be evacuating anyone from that area. I guess it's a toss up whether it was the hostile programs that killed her, or the synaptic shock when the simulation around her freaked.

phase.briefing:
You have done well, operative, but the task of restoring Richland is far from complete.
Scan analysis has revealed unusual activity by Furies gang members at the indicated location. Override routines have been detected in the area. Any infected programs are to be eliminated.

enter.say:
Uh-oh, I've got a big one in there.
If it's one of those big floating balls, you can leave that alone for now. Just concentrate on the actual overridden bipeds.

done.say: Nice. You're all done in there.

phase.briefing:
Almost all code in the proximity of the battle zone suffered at least some degree of override damage. It is remarkable, then, that our scans have found what appears to be small collection of fragmentary code entirely unaffected by the overrides.
Locate and retrieve these fragments, {player}.

enter.say: It isn't anything I can spot on my screen. You'll have to poke around. Oh, there is a bluepill in there, though. That should be...Hyman Franguiadakis, according to the Machine records.

done.say: Think I should call one of our shrinks in? Those could be simulation rejection symptoms, right?

objective.text: Search the area for the code fragments

done.say: Scanning for override damage... Huh, clean as a whistle. Must be what we're after.

phase.briefing: Take the fragments to Agent Pace at the data analysis center indicated on your heads-up display, operative.

enter.say: That's the data lab. Take those babies straight to Pace.

talk.say: Ciao, {player}. Please hand the fragments to Ms. Underson.

objective.text: Give the Frags to Technician Underson

done.say:
Oh, I just take the data and copy it to the computer. The systems do all the work.
If you want to know the results, Tomi should have them in the next room any second now.

talk.say:
Well, hi there! You must be Operative {player}, who found the fragments. Congrats!
Let me see... Mm-hm... Well now, these appear to be part of the same code as some other fragments our operatives found several weeks ago while searching for the Oracle! How about that?
Oh, there's more. Hm... My! By combining the data, the systems were able to confirm that these fragments must have been left over from the process of writing a kill code! How interesting!

mission.finish:
The Oracle's involvement in a surreptitious plot with certain Exiles has been suspected for several recent months, {player}, but if she is using her unique logic processes to craft termination codes, the nature of her activities could be much more dangerous than anticipated.
In the past few days, she appears to have contacted leaders of both the Cypherites and E Pluribus Neo. Our Cypherite sources report that she delivered an encrypted code, but its nature is unknown, and the Cypherites have not delivered a formal-- Excuse me a moment.
I've just been given a report that Halborn and Carlyne have been seen with Merovingian operatives. Locating them will be our top priority. You will be contacted when an assignment is prepared.
